params.adoption_metric: CC-M1-3.2: conditional walled value >= G1-$100 OR marginal union recall >= +0.2pp OR DP seat share >= 5%
params.baseline: m1/generation_v2 union roster (the S1-v2 frozen oracle)
params.era: FIT 2021-2024 mines and decides; 2025 is an eval-only echo
params.fd1: last 1800s of every phase run + the settlement window [RTH_HI-1800s, RTH_HI); delays [15, 60]
params.fd3: first 600s after FOMC 14:00 ET (meeting last day) and the fixed 08:30/10:00 ET slots; delays [15, 60]; BOJ unavailable pre-2026
params.fd4: first confirmation strictly after a causal shock episode ends: trailing-150s SANE mid range >= $1000, or a run of >= 10s wide-but-two-sided (D-054 insane) seconds; delay tau*
params.fd5: earliest confirming touch per (session, kept level family); touch_count==1 carried as the VIRGIN sub-tag; delay tau*
params.fd6: entry mid beyond an OR_EXT k>=1.5 level (adopted CC-M1-6.1 cells; FD6_ANY = all segment x OR-minute cells); delay tau*
params.levels: m1/levels_v3 (D-053 bands under the D-054 mask)
params.slice_cells: every axis marginal + every 2-way axis pair, cells with n_FIT >= 500 only
params.slice_promotion: Holm-rejected AND value >= G1_asset + $150 AND the per-FIT-year edge keeps its sign in all four years
params.slice_statistic: conditional walled value = mean phase-close walled certificate over candidates with value > 0 (FIT era)
params.slice_test: one-sided Welch z of the slice's positive certificates vs the complement's, normal tail; Holm step-down at alpha=0.05 over EVERY tested cell of that asset
